# lean4-lsp

Lean 4 language server for enhanced code intelligence in Claude Code.

## Supported Extensions

- `.lean` - Lean 4 source files

## Installation

### Prerequisites

Install Lean 4 via [elan](https://github.com/leanprover/elan), the Lean version manager:

```bash
curl https://elan.lean-lang.org/install.sh -sSf | sh
```

Verify the language server is available:

```bash
lean --server <<< ''
```

### Plugin Installation

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/TheDarkchip/lean4-lsp.git
claude plugin install lean4-lsp
```

## More Information

- [Lean 4](https://lean-lang.org/)
- [Lean 4 GitHub](https://github.com/leanprover/lean4)
- [elan](https://github.com/leanprover/elan)
- [Mathlib](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4)
